Nearby, a suction unit and electrocautery device sit next to a defibrillator and an oxygen cylinder fitted with a ventilation tube. A stitching kit and a kidney dish lie on a side table beside a pedal bin. There is no patient, no visitor, no flower vase, no wall clock, and no telephone.
